about_short_description.short_description: Al Seer Marine is a portfolio of services that caters to all needs of boat owners, managers and crew.

product.name: Commercial Management and Commercial Services
product.description: Management and commercial operations of tankers, bulk carriers, and gas carriers including chartering, freight negotiations, and financial risk monitoring.

product.name: Maintenance Services
product.description: Comprehensive maintenance and repair services for vessels, covering mechanical, electrical, structural, and cosmetic needs to ensure operational readiness.

product.name: Boat Building
product.description: Design and construction of custom composite boats and superyachts up to 160 meters, including repairs and fabrication of composite components.

product.name: Training Institute
product.description: Provides certified training programs for manned and unmanned vessels, including practical and theoretical instruction with customized curricula.

product.name: Yacht Management
product.description: Management services for superyachts including operational oversight, crew management, and maintenance coordination.

product.name: Unmanned Systems
product.description: Development and manufacturing of modular unmanned surface vessels adaptable to various platforms for maritime applications.
